subject: claims this repo made and later measurements overturned
how_to_search: Use engine.corrections.search_corrections with a word from id, tags, wrong, or correction. A hit is a retracted claim, not a reading.
rules: Append a record when a later measurement contradicts an earlier claim from this repo.
Do not edit a record already in the list. Point at it with supersedes.
A subagent note is not a correction until the contradicting measurement is in the repo.
solved is always false. claimed_plaintext is always null. Do not store a letter string.

records.wrong: Raising the order score to the English line, or past it, is progress toward a reading.
records.correction: Sorting the cells scores 2.3931, above English at 1.0658, and sorting is not a message. A reading has to be language and it has to regenerate the cells.

records.wrong: An index of coincidence above 0.06 means the cells are language.
records.correction: The cells already score 0.069702. They pass that cutoff and they are not a reading.

records.wrong: The five symbols that never leave the last column are filler, and deleting them would reveal the message.
records.correction: Deleting them drops the order score from 0.5706 to 0.4174. Every other eight-cell cut scores higher. They are not filler.

records.wrong: A reported period of 7 is a separate key length.
records.correction: Those positions are the last column, read at half resolution. They are not a 7-letter key.

records.wrong: Column shares of 0.1847, 0.1256, and 0.1226, with no shuffled grid matching, mean a second pattern on the row-end seam.
records.correction: A boundary pair was counted for both columns. Counted once, column 13 is 0.0953 and column 12 is 0.0894, and 7 of 10,000 shuffled grids match 0.0953. Almost all of both numbers is the private symbols.

records.wrong: The published two-square score -692.13 can be converted onto this repo's order score or chi-square.
records.correction: No formula for that score was published. It is stored as a ball from -692.135 to -692.125 and it is not compared to anything.

records.wrong: Replacing the single cell 04 with 75 improves the chi-square.
records.correction: In the rate balls, the cells sit between 34.174639 and 34.292468. The 75 replacement sits between 35.886775 and 36.007091, entirely worse. 0 of 24 replacements improve the ball.

records.wrong: Beating a published chi-square of 49.23 means this repo is in the lead on a solution.
records.correction: The cells themselves score about 34.2, so they beat that candidate, and they are still the unsolved cells. Nobody has a sentence that regenerates them. Two count-moves cannot clear the English frequency line: the best two-move ball reaches 27.557769, above 24.165.
